quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson breaks down the Sixers' offensive execution against the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: They get Jaylen Brown into the post against a mismatch. Quick swing, ball screen, easy shot for Embiid.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey is on the wing. He sets a cross screen for Jaylen Brown. Asar Thompson was on him. They get Jaylen Brown into the post against a mismatch. Quick swing, ball screen, you got to help on Tyrese Maxey, easy shot for Joel Embiid. What the fuck are you supposed to do? Everyone says you could have helped off LeBron James. Okay, help off LeBron James. Then get cooked. Go to the very beginning again, huh? If right here, he could easily just throw the ball to Jaylen Brown, that's a bucket. Jenkins has no fucking shot. And then the other thing is, you have to worry about everything on the floor. The person who has the ball just scored 16,000 fucking field goals made. 16,000 field goals made and you can't help? How do you guard this team?
